description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller advice class for global exception handling within the order-service module. It provides standardized responses for validation-related exceptions, illegal argument exceptions, and general exceptions.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring REST controller advice class that handles various exceptions globally for the order-service, returning standardized JSON error responses.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions such as MethodArgumentNotValidException, BindException, and ConstraintViolationException, returning a bad request response with details.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException, returning a bad request response with the exception message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning an internal server error response indicating an unexpected error.
